run_interactive_play: run the interactive play script to manually control an articulated agent in the Habitat environment
run_play_env: run the play_env function to execute an interactive simulation loop with keyboard controls and rendering
run_get_input_vel_ctlr: run get_input_vel_ctlr to process pygame keyboard input and return environment step actions for the agent
run_FreeCamHelper: run the FreeCamHelper class to toggle and control a free camera mode with rotation and translation keys
run_step_env: run step_env to execute a single environment step with a named action and its arguments
